scripts.e2e:perf: node -e 'const fs = require("node:fs"), os = require("node:os"), path = require("node:path"), cp = require("node:child_process"); const root = process.cwd(), dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "reviewer-perf-config-")), config = path.join(dir, "playwright.config.mts"), at = p => JSON.stringify(path.join(root, p)); try { fs.writeFileSync(config, `import base from ${at("playwright.config.ts")}; export default { ...base, testDir: ${at("e2e/perf")}, globalSetup: ${at("e2e/global-setup.ts")}, globalTeardown: ${at("e2e/global-teardown.ts")}, projects: [{ name: "perf", testMatch: "**/perf.e2e.ts" }] };`); const r = cp.spawnSync(process.execPath, [path.join(root, "node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js"), "test", "--config", config, ...process.argv.slice(1)], { stdio: "inherit" }); if (r.error) throw r.error; process.exitCode = r.status ?? 1; } finally { fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }' --
